  • Haida↗Continuing specific community and government connection
    Connection & source
    Continuing specific community and government connection

    The Council of the Haida Nation's joint release locates Haida Gwaii off the northern coast of British Columbia, identifies the Council and its stewardship mandate, and describes the continuing Haida relationship with Haida Gwaii. This record uses the explicit place/community connection, not later legal-status conclusions. It covers Haida Gwaii and does not subsume the separate Kaigani Haida jurisdiction in Alaska or imply Haida presence throughout British Columbia.

    Joint community/provincial publication dated April 14, 2024; geography inspected 2026-10-21. Reviewed 2026-10-21.

Inspection: Actual About introduction, lines 58–62. Restricted member portal, present figures and program claims were not reviewed.

    Living community account and historical land relationship; inspected October 21, 2026. Reviewed 2026-10-21.
